text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
During the training camp, Chairwoman 
Akikawa came by for an inspection.

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Ooh, working hard despite the heat! Good 
job, good job!
choice_data_list:
Chairwoman Akikawa, coming all the way to 
the training camp despite your busy 
schedule?

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
What, consider it a morale visit. Hmph, is 
that <chrname> running out there?

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Since her debut, her performance has been 
truly remarkable. She has even become a 
frequent topic of conversation in URA 
meetings.
choice_data_list:
I'll do everything in my power to help you 
succeed on the world stage

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Indeed! You're impressive enough as it is, 
but your goal is to reach the top of the 
world!

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Even among the superstars of DREAMS, her 
talent shines bright. Please, let her 
bloom on the world stage!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
One year left until the big day. Time may 
be limited, but let's give it everything 
we've got.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
All to see her become number one in the 
world, and witness 'DREAMS' with our own 
eyes!

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Indeed! Never be satisfied with the status 
quo, and never succumb to pride.

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Without resting on your laurels as a 
promising prospect, I want you to aim 
higher and higher!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Chairwoman Akikawa is right. For now, the 
acclaim is still limited in scope.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
If you're aiming to win the BC, being 
top-class domestically is practically the 
bare minimum requirement.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Single-mindedly focused and with renewed 
determination, they returned to guiding <chrname>.
